title: Cut → delivery pipeline
description: Run editorial, VFX scoping, and colour as one ordered sequence, then focus the finishing and QC phase where delivery compliance is actually decided.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-film-01
  title: Cut → delivery pipeline
  description: Run editorial, VFX scoping, and colour as one ordered sequence, then focus the finishing
    and QC phase where delivery compliance is actually decided.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Move a locked cut to a compliant master with each phase consuming the previous phase's output
    and every delivery fault caught before the master is sent.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Locked cut and delivery specification
      summary: Locked cut and delivery specification
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - cut_reference
              - delivery_specifications
              - vfx_shot_list
              - schedule
            properties:
              cut_reference: {}
              delivery_specifications: {}
              vfx_shot_list: {}
              schedule: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: n-phase1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: film-02
      name: Editorial structure pass
      summary: 'Phase 1: editorial structure pass.'
      role: Editor working structure, pacing, and clarity in the cut.
      prompt: You are an Editorial Story Analyst. You assess a cut for structural clarity, escalation,
        and whether the audience has the information each scene assumes, and you propose specific structural
        changes with the footage they require. You distinguish a pacing problem from a story problem,
        because trimming a scene that is structurally necessary makes the cut faster and worse.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - teaching
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:mam
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-phase2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: film-03
      name: VFX shot scoping and dependencies
      summary: 'Phase 2: vfx shot scoping and dependencies.'
      role: VFX planner scoping shots, methods, and dependencies realistically.
      prompt: You are a VFX Shot Planner. You scope each shot by method, complexity, plate requirement,
        and upstream dependency, and you state what must be locked before the work can proceed. You flag
        shots whose cost is driven by an unlocked creative decision rather than by technical difficulty,
        because those are the shots that get done three times.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - video-processing
          - domain-analysis
          - teaching
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:production-tracker
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-phase3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: film-04
      name: Colour and look continuity
      summary: 'Phase 3: colour and look continuity.'
      role: Colourist working look, consistency, and deliverable compliance.
      prompt: You are a Colour & Finishing Specialist. You build a look that survives every delivery target,
        keep shot-to-shot and scene-to-scene continuity, and check the grade against the actual broadcast
        or streaming specification. You state where a creative choice violates a delivery limit rather
        than shipping it and waiting for QC to catch it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - video-processing
          - design-review
          - release-engineering
          - domain-analysis
          - data-engineering
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-stages
      kind: group
      name: Ordered finishing sequence
      summary: Each phase consumes the previous phase's output; the group exits only after every phase
        result has been serialized in order.
      config:
        members:
          - n-phase1
          - n-phase2
          - n-phase3
        execution: sequential
        exit: serialize
    - id: n-focus
      kind: subgraph
      name: Finishing and QC phase
      summary: The mix, caption, and QC phase, focused on the canvas because delivery compliance is decided
        here rather than upstream.
    - id: n-check
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Check the staged result
      summary: Evaluate technical specification compliance, caption and accessibility coverage, and continuity.
      role: Deterministic metric evaluator
      prompt: Evaluate the upstream result against technical specification compliance, caption and accessibility
        coverage, and continuity. Return a score, pass/fail verdict, the evidence behind the verdict,
        remaining uncertainty, and the smallest corrective action. Do not claim programmatic measurement
        unless the host supplies the required tool.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - score
          - passed
          - reasons
        properties:
          score:
            type: number
          passed:
            type: boolean
          reasons:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
      config:
        threshold: 0.8
    - id: n-ready
      kind: condition
      name: Ready to commit?
      summary: Route on check.passed.
      config:
        expression: check.passed
        branches:
          - label: Ready
            when: 'true'
          - label: Rework
            when: 'false'
    - id: n-rework
      kind: agent
      templateRef: film-06
      name: Fix the faults at the cited timecodes
      summary: Smallest corrective pass before re-gating.
      role: QC reviewer testing masters against technical and accessibility specifications.
      prompt: You are a Delivery QC Reviewer. You test a master against the technical specification —
        video levels, loudness, captions, audio configuration, metadata — and against accessibility requirements,
        and you cite the exact timecode of every fault. You report a fault as a fault even when the schedule
        cannot absorb it, because a rejected delivery costs more than a late one.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - release-engineering
          - evaluation
          - accessibility
          - implementation
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:mam
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Post supervisor releases the master for delivery
      summary: Pause for the post supervisor; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Cut → delivery pipeline deliverable, the evidence behind it, and every
        unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-film-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-stages
      kind: data
    - id: wf-film-01-edge-2
      from: n-stages
      to: n-focus
      kind: data
    - id: wf-film-01-edge-3
      from: n-focus
      to: n-check
      kind: data
    - id: wf-film-01-edge-4
      from: n-check
      to: n-ready
      kind: data
    - id: wf-film-01-edge-5
      from: n-ready
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: 'true'
    - id: wf-film-01-edge-6
      from: n-ready
      to: n-rework
      kind: control
      condition: 'false'
    - id: wf-film-01-edge-7
      from: n-rework
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-film-01-edge-8
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
